import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react' import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom' import axios from 'axios' export const PurchaseOrderListScreen = () => { const [purchaseOrders, setPurchaseOrders] = useState([]) const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false) const [error, setError] = useState(null) const [filter, setFilter] = useState({ status: '', vendor: '', dateFrom: '', dateTo: '' }) const navigate = useNavigate() const API_BASE_URL = process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL || 'https://celerant-backend.agreeablemeadow-3f37c30d.westus2.azurecontainerapps.io' useEffect(() => { loadPurchaseOrders() }, [filter]) const loadPurchaseOrders = async () => { setLoading(true) setError(null) try { const params = new URLSearchParams() if (filter.status) params.append('status', filter.status) if (filter.vendor) params.append('vendor', filter.vendor) if (filter.dateFrom) params.append('date_from', filter.dateFrom) if (filter.dateTo) params.append('date_to', filter.dateTo) const response = await axios.get(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/purchase-orders`, { params }) setPurchaseOrders(response.data || []) } catch (err: any) { setError( err.response?.data?.detail || err.message || 'Failed to load purchase orders' ) } finally { setLoading(false) } } const handleViewDetails = (poId: number) => { navigate(`/purchase-orders/${poId}`) } const handleNewPO = () => { // Navigate to create new PO (not implemented in this version) alert('Create new PO functionality would be implemented here') } return (
